claims.claim_text_en: The 2024 spring floods displaced about 12,000 people in the Northern basin and caused estimated losses of USD 90 million.

brief.core_idea_en: In the pages read, NDC 3.0 describes the 2024 flood impact in the Northern basin but states no flood or coastal protection measure. The only flood response found is the early-warning action under DRM-03.

concerns.text_en: Spring floods in 2024 displaced about 12,000 people in the Northern basin and caused USD 90 million in losses.

numbers.text_en: About 12,000 displaced; USD 90 million in losses; Northern basin; 2024 (NDC 3.0, p. 8).

gaps.text_en: No structural or nature-based flood protection measure appears in the pages read.
